The checkpoints of the [experimental models](../experimental/index.md), in the same form as the [checkpoint cards](index.md): the parameters, the SHA-256 of the weights and the value `reproduce.py` gives from them (Reproduced).

The SHA-256 is that of the weights file: the table shows its first 12 characters, and the full value is in the details and in the [checkpoint inventory](../checkpoint_inventory.csv). Code is licensed LGPL-3.0-only; the licence of the weights is on their Hugging Face repository (Download column). To reproduce the numbers, see [Reproduce our benchmarks](../reproducibility.md).

## ShapeNetCar

Code: `scripts/benchmarks/shapenetcar/`. Dataset: [dataset guide](../../dataset_guide/shapenetcar.md).

Metric: surface rel. L2 (%).

| Model | Checkpoint | Parameters | SHA-256 | Reproduced | Download |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GIWO | `shapenetcar_giwo` | 3,752,638 | `6904790e72f1` | 20.17 | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/zenteiq-ai/scirex-giwo-shapenetcar) |

??? note "Configuration and training"

    **GIWO**, `shapenetcar_giwo`

    - Weights: `params.msgpack`
    - SHA-256: 6904790e72f18bdcc19aaabdebfb9d4050ebf35c3a8c2115013c46c50986f860
    - Architecture: latent_grid=10, width=15, n_layers=4, level=1, wavelet="db4", gno_mlp_hidden=[64, 64], in_gno_radius=0.3, out_gno_radius=1.65
    - Training: learning_rate=0.001, n_epochs=200, pct_start=0.3, n_train=789
    - Epoch rule: final epoch (train.py saves the weights after the last epoch)
